sourceDescription:
Idéal Investissement Locatif - Proche de l’Avenue de Laon et de la Rue Lesage à Reims.

Venez découvrir ce chaleureux studio de 17m2 environ et 33m2 environ au sol,

Situé au 3e étage sur 3 d’une copropriété, il est composé d’une pièce de vie avec cuisine et d’une salle de douche avec WC.

Le studio est actuellement libre de tout occupation.

Ne manquez pas cette opportunité et contactez votre conseiller sans
tarder !

*Un appartement T2 (libre de tout occupation) est également
disponible à la vente au sein de la copropriété.

La presente annonce immobiliere vise 1 lot situé dans une copropriété de 18 lots au total et ne faisant l'objet d'aucune procédure en cours citée à l'article L. 721-1 du code de la construction et de l'habitation. Montant moyen mensuel de charges déclaré par le vendeur : 35.63€ par mois (soit 427.52 € annuel). Honoraires d'agence à la charge du vendeur.
La présentation d'une pièce d'identité en cours de validité sera demandée à la visite, conformément à l'article L.561-5 du Code monétaire et financier. Les informations sur les risques auxquels ce bien est exposé, y compris l'obligation légale de débroussaillement, sont disponibles sur le site Géorisques : http://www.georisques.gouv.fr.
La présente annonce immobilière a été rédigée sous la responsabilité éditoriale de M Guillaume Hemery-Boi mandataire indépendant en immobilier (sans détention de fonds), agent commercial de la SAS I@D France immatriculé au RSAC de reims sous le numéro 893442137, titulaire de la carte de démarchage immobilier pour le compte de la société I@D France SAS.

photoReview.observation: Original furnished attic main room with sloping roof, white-painted exposed beams, roof window, grey sofa, desk and white fitted kitchenette with grey backsplash, oven, hob, sink and under-counter fridge. Roof geometry is consistent with separate habitable and floor areas; measurements not verified.
Another view of same kitchenette/main room with roof window, sofa, round table and two chairs. Not a second room; furniture alone does not establish tenancy.

Reverse of main room showing open sleeping recess with double bed, same beams, roof windows, sofa and table. No door enclosing a separate bedroom; retain source studio/one room/zero separate bedrooms.

Original shower room under sloping roof with roof window, black-framed shower, grey wall tiles, white basin/black vanity and black drawers. WC stated in prose but not visible; no numeric floor or lift inference from photos.

dedupeEvidence.resolution: APPROVED: whole EUR 79,900 asking price with seller-paid agency fees for one 17 m2 studio. The prose explicitly distinguishes about 17 m2 from about 33 m2 floor area; sloping roof photos are coherent with that distinction. Use exposed 17 m2 living-area for analysis; do not add or replace with 33 m2, and do not assert an unexposed certified Carrez measurement. Third and top floor of three expressly stated; elevator unexposed and unknown, omitted rather than false. Source 1949 construction, one sale lot in a coownership of 18 TOTAL lots, no stated proceeding, EUR 427.52 annual charges / rounded EUR 35.63 monthly. Electric heating, interphone, DPE D303 / GES B9 assessed 2025-03-19, energy EUR 490-690 indexed to 2023 preserved exactly; no inferred reclassification from consumption alone. All four original own photos visually inspected: coherent furnished attic kitchenette/living room and open bed recess with sloping roofs, white exposed beams and roof windows, plus grey/black shower room. Open sleeping recess is not a separate enclosed bedroom; source one room and zero bedrooms retained. No AI label or apparent geometry mismatch observed. WC asserted in prose but not visible in shower photo. The full wording explicitly states currently free of occupation; this is a seller assertion, independently unconfirmed. Another free T2 in the same coownership is offered separately, not included in this studio price or room count. No evidence-backed current tenancy, viager, bare/fractional/timeshare ownership, auction/starting/partial price, managed/commercial lease, ancillary-only asset, houseboat, bot/spam or impossible room/surface combination established. Exact source ID and all four own image paths absent across approved, pending, excluded, duplicate and export evidence. Near C21 15839983033 / ref17573 is a ground-floor 15 m2 cathedral studio with outside storage, EUR 307.10 annual current charges and a 2026-08-07 diagnostic; pending Citya14/15 TAPP406-972872 is ground floor, F503, EUR 1,000 annual charges, 10 lots and a turquoise-wall narrow studio, requiring surface clarification. Their preserved full descriptions and reviews materially differ from this third-floor attic Avenue de Laon/Rue Lesage D303 / 18-lot / EUR 427.52 unit. Reims actual local rent and apartment DVF coverage verified before analysis.
